svg.title: StockCopilot — proposed AWS architecture
svg.desc: AWS architecture diagram for the MVP: operational sources, ingestion, state, lakehouse, machine learning, four Lambda workloads, the copilot, dashboard, approval, and learning.
svg.text: StockCopilot — AWS architecture for the MVP
Operational data → forecast → economic simulation → human approval → learning
Proposed architecture · no deployed AWS inventory
in the repository documentation are shown.
Synchronous entry and decoupled events · current state separate from history
Commercial generation and decisioning · two entry points, one shared economic engine
The model forecasts · the engine decides · Bedrock interprets and explains · the person approves

g.text: Plan of up to 5 viable strategies · complete impact · draft, never automatic activation

text.tspan: without a VPC while only using

g.text: VPC only if a private resource is introduced.

svg.text: sales · margin · units · waste · stockouts · approval/rejection · context
S3 Raw → cleans and publishes S3 Curated; Glue is the scalable alternative.
Scheduler/signal → gets context, creates candidates, and calls the engine.
Planner/Copilot → simulates impact and optimizes compatible strategies.
API Gateway → validates the contract and orchestrates Bedrock and bounded tools.

text.tspan: 1 Sources send requests or events to API Gateway / EventBridge.
2 Current state goes to DynamoDB; history enters S3 Raw.
3 ETL normalizes and publishes Curated; Athena queries history.
4 EventBridge starts the plan; Strategy Planner creates candidates.
5 Decision Engine uses forecast, state, and constraints to simulate.
6 The prompt enters through API/Copilot; Bedrock interprets safe tools.
7 The dashboard shows plans; the manager retains final decision-making.
8 Results return to state, history, and the next evaluation.
• Conceptual architecture; there is no IaC or deployed AWS inventory.
• Lambdas without a VPC in the proposed design.
• VPC only when a private resource is required.
• Bedrock explains; it does not calculate economic impact.
